title: Challenges to the cosmological constant model following results from the Dark Energy Survey (Avila, Mena-Fernández, Vincenzi)
efc_relevance: Nature Astronomy perspective consolidating DES Y6 BAO+SN Ia together with Planck CMB into a ~3σ preference for dynamical dark energy over the cosmological constant. Sits directly on top of EFC's P1/P4 sealed predictions: the data trend (w-evolution sign change in the same z-range as EFC's lensing crossover at z ~ 0.44) is now framed as a community-level challenge to ΛCDM rather than a DESI-only anomaly, raising the prior weight on any framework — including EFC — that natively predicts a dynamical-DE signature without invoking a new field.
ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger as a Stage-IV synthesis row (cluster desi_dr2_de_evolution); flag in Likelihood Ledger as the canonical 'why-not-ΛCDM' citation going forward; update framework:LCDM-Planck2018 row with the ~3σ DES+Planck challenge note; update framework:wCDM-CPL-Chevallier2001 row with the DES Y6 best-fit w0–wa region as the new comparison contour; cross-reference arXiv:2601.14559 (DES Y6) and arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2).
